name: Youth Arts Council
what_you_do: Go behind the scenes at the museum, meet professional artists, learn silkscreen printing and plan teen events such as Youth Invasion.
who_can_apply: Pittsburgh area teens ages 15 to 18 (high school students).
duration: Weekly Thursdays 3:30 to 6 p.m., Oct 15, 2026 to May 2027
deadline_text: Application deadline: Friday, October 9, 2026 (the day this page was read). Weekly meetings start October 15, 2026.
how_to_apply: Submit the online application by the deadline. Work samples are optional. Email teens@warhol.org with questions. Bus tickets are available for transportation.
notes: The 2026-27 deadline falls on 2026-10-09, so email teens@warhol.org to ask whether late applications are accepted. The Warhol also hires paid Student Assistants and runs a free Teen DJ Academy (ages 14 to 18, stipend) and School of Drag (ages 14 to 18); see the Teens page.
